mentions.name: Rational Grid
mentions.description: A multi-player LLM interface built on an underlying graph data structure, combined with a publishing platform, that lets people work together to explore deep questions. Built with Elixir, Phoenix, LiveView, and Cytoscape.
mentions.audience: People working together to explore deep questions
mentions.source_excerpt: For the past year and half or so, I have been building https://rationalgrid.ai with the goal of bringing together a multi-player LLM interface (based on a underlying graph data structure) and publishing platform, for people to work together to explore deep questions.
mentions.author: TomBers
